libri3000m.flac.text: But Shasta is always at home to those who love her, and is ever in a thrill of enthusiastic activity,

libri174m.flac.text: She who was so abundantly living, who could love like a burst of sunshine, and give herself as God gives the world.

libri84f.flac.text: So high they rose that they were lost to sight. His limbs were gold so far as he was bird, and white the others with vermilion mingled.
